verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs say every PR gets its own preview URL through Deploy Previews, which also offer shareable preview environments, and community users confirm PR preview builds. That gives a team parallel per-branch environments. The evidence does not establish that these environments are unlimited or fully isolated beyond the frontend deploy, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented absence of limits on concurrent environments, evidence of isolated per-environment backends/data (e.g., databases or secrets scoped per preview), and explicit multi-developer concurrency guarantees.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up unlimited isolated environments so my whole team can ship simultaneously
